name: Medtronic
whatTheyBuild: Pacemakers, insulin pumps, surgical robotics, deep brain stimulators.
whyItMatters: The largest standalone medical technology company in the world. Their devices are implanted in millions of patients annually.

name: GE HealthCare
whatTheyBuild: MRI machines, CT scanners, ultrasound systems, patient monitors.
whyItMatters: A pioneer in medical imaging. If you've ever had a scan in a hospital, it was likely on their equipment.

name: Siemens Healthineers
whatTheyBuild: Lab diagnostics, imaging systems, advanced robotics for minimally invasive procedures.
whyItMatters: They dominate the global market for in-vitro diagnostics and medical imaging systems.

name: Philips
whatTheyBuild: Defibrillators, respiratory care systems, imaging solutions.
whyItMatters: Transitioned from a general electronics conglomerate to a laser-focused health technology leader.

name: Abbott
whatTheyBuild: Continuous glucose monitors (FreeStyle Libre), diagnostic tests, stents.
whyItMatters: Their rapid diagnostic testing changed the landscape of point-of-care testing during the pandemic.

name: Johnson & Johnson MedTech
whatTheyBuild: Joint replacements, surgical staplers, contact lenses, electrophysiology catheters.
whyItMatters: One of the most comprehensive surgical and orthopaedic product lines in the world.

name: Stryker
whatTheyBuild: Robotic-arm assisted surgery (Mako), hospital beds, neurovascular devices.
whyItMatters: Incredibly innovative in orthopaedics and surgical robotics, leading the shift toward personalized joint replacements.

name: Boston Scientific
whatTheyBuild: Stents, pacemakers, deep brain stimulation systems, endoscopic instruments.
whyItMatters: A massive focus on minimally invasive medical technologies that reduce recovery times and surgical risks.

name: BD (Becton, Dickinson)
whatTheyBuild: Syringes, infusion pumps, biosciences instruments, diagnostic systems.
whyItMatters: The backbone of clinical care delivery; billions of their devices are used daily worldwide.

name: Baxter International
whatTheyBuild: Dialysis systems, IV solutions, smart infusion pumps, advanced surgery tools.
whyItMatters: Pioneered commercial kidney dialysis and continues to lead in critical and renal care.
